name: quant-ai
description: Enterprise AI quantitative market intelligence and trading workstation for Indian financial markets
author: Yuva DevLab <yuva.devlab@gmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @quant-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/ui build && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/api build && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @quant-ai/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @quant-ai/contracts test && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/ui test && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/api test && pnpm --filter @quant-ai/web test
